title: Ensemble delivery manifest
description: Schema for a workload's delivery.yml, as parsed by kit-sdk/deploy/manifest/parser.ts. Reference values use the ${category.name.output} or ${release.name} grammar.

release.description: How to pack a ship this workload's compute entries reference via ${release.<name>.image}. Built by pack kits.

deploy.description: The workload's resources, one map per category, keyed by resource name.

networking.description: Networking resources (gateway, implemented only on compose today, or any other generic kind).

secrets.description: Secrets sourced externally (file or environment), never minted by ens.

variables.description: Developer-owned, valueless entries supplied at deploy time. Permissive passthrough bag.

external.description: Resources ens does not provision, only references.

kit.description: The pack kit used to build this release.

mode.description: Optional pack mode passed through to the pack kit.

outputName.description: Optional name of the release's non-primary output.

publishSpec.description: Where and under what name a released ship is published.

options.description: Publish options, handed to the pack kit's publish.ts.

resourceDeclaration.description: A typed resource declaration for a category with no seeded ResourceContract yet. Per-type fields beyond type/class/capabilities are validated by whatever contract a kit registers for it, not this schema.

type.description: The resource type. Matched against a registered ResourceContract.

class.description: Optional resource class (e.g. critical) affecting how a kit realizes it.

capabilities.description: Optional negotiated capabilities requested from the deploy kit.

class.description: Optional resource class (e.g. critical) affecting how a kit realizes it.

capabilities.description: Optional negotiated capabilities requested from the deploy kit.

ports.description: Named port map, individually referenceable as ${compute.<name>.<port>}.

env.description: Environment variables, values may be literals or ${...} references.

networks.description: Networks this container attaches to, usually ${external.<name>.name} references.

mounts.description: Storage volumes to attach, usually referencing a storage.volume entry's ${storage.<name>.name} output.

storageVolumeResource.description: A `storage.volume.v1` entry (kit-sdk/deploy/contracts/seeds/storage-volume.ts) — a persistent, named volume with no shape of its own; a compute attaches to it via `mounts`, referencing this entry's `${storage.<name>.name}` output.

class.description: Optional resource class (e.g. critical) affecting how a kit realizes it.

capabilities.description: Optional negotiated capabilities requested from the deploy kit.

path.description: Path inside the container to mount the volume at.

readOnly.description: Mount the volume read-only. Defaults to false.

objectStorageResource.description: An `object-storage.v1` entry (kit-sdk/deploy/contracts/seeds/object-storage.ts) — an S3-compatible bucket. `accessKeySecret`/`secretKeySecret` are required on compose (Garage has no other way to get static credentials) but silently dropped on aws (IAM mints its own, it can't import a caller-chosen pair) — see the contract's own comment.

class.description: Optional resource class (e.g. critical) — on compose, only `critical` gets a persistent volume for the bucket's data.

capabilities.description: Optional negotiated capabilities requested from the deploy kit.

accessKeySecret.description: Name of a secrets entry supplying the S3 access key ID. Required on compose, dropped on aws.

secretKeySecret.description: Name of a secrets entry supplying the S3 secret access key. Required on compose, dropped on aws.

class.description: Optional resource class (e.g. critical) — required for deletionProtection/backupRetention/multiAz to materialize on some kits.

capabilities.description: Optional negotiated capabilities requested from the deploy kit (e.g. read-replicas).

passwordSecret.description: Name of a secrets entry supplying the password.

init.description: Optional list of repo-relative SQL/shell file paths to run against a fresh database on startup (compose mounts them into postgres's docker-entrypoint-initdb.d, in filename order; silently dropped on aws, which has no equivalent for an already-provisioned RDS instance).

developmentBlock.description: Developer-owned intent for `ens deploy --watch`, honored only by provisioners that support it. Sync rules are grouped by action: `sync` just copies files over, `sync+restart` additionally restarts the container so the process picks them up.

app.description: App whose source (relative to that app's own source directory) is kept in sync.

path.description: Path inside the deployed container to keep current with the app's source.

ignore.description: Glob patterns to exclude from sync.

gatewayResource.description: A `gateway.v1` entry (kit-sdk/deploy/contracts/seeds/gateway.ts) — an HTTP ingress that host/path-routes to compute targets. Implemented only on compose today (nginx); declaring one targeting aws has no provisioner to satisfy it.

class.description: Optional resource class (e.g. critical) affecting how a kit realizes it.

capabilities.description: Optional negotiated capabilities requested from the deploy kit.

network.description: The (typically external) network this gateway joins, usually ${external.<name>.name}.

tls.description: Accepted but not yet implemented by the compose provisioner, which always serves plain HTTP regardless of its value.

host.description: The Host header this route matches.

path.description: A plain prefix string (the full request URI is forwarded unchanged), or { match, strip: true } to strip the matched prefix before forwarding.

target.description: The compute to route to. `service` is a plain compute name (never a reference); `port` is usually ${compute.<name>.<port>} — split apart because that reference alone always bakes to a bare port number, never the compute's own name.

strip.description: Strip the matched prefix before forwarding to the target. Defaults to false.

source.description: Where the secret's value comes from.

name.description: The external resource's name, as it exists outside ens's management.
